name: utility_performance_monitor
title: Utility Performance Monitor
summary: Dev-only FPS and performance panel on previews.
description: Dev tool: a small panel on platform previews with live FPS, frame times, jank, long tasks (blocking time), LCP, CLS and interaction delay, plus a 0-100 score and an auto scroll test. Turned on in the platform (Settings > Platform tools > Performance monitor, dev/platform/data/settings.json tools.performance_monitor). Never rendered in compiled (dist) pages. Its css / js are printed inline, so they are not part of the production bundle.
